ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT ("Agreement")dated asof July23,2007,betweenWEST125THREALTYCORP.,a New York corporation having an address at 1220 Lexington Avenue, New York, NY 10028 ("Transferor") and 125 PROPERTY INTERESTS LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at c/o Reisman Property Interests, Inc., 340 West Passaic Street, Rochelle Park, NJ 07662 ("Transferee"; Transferor and Transferee are sometimes hereinafter each referred to singly as a "party" and collectively as the "parties.") WITNESSETH THAT: WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner of certain land ("Transferor's Land") in the City of New York, and the building and improvements thereon ("Transferor's Building"), located at 17 West 125th Street, New York, New York and known as Block 1723, Lot 23 on the Tax Map (the "Tax Map") of the City of New York (the "City"), New York County and more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land, together with Transferor's Building being herein called "Transferor's Premises"); and WHEREAS, Transferee is the lessee of a parcel of land located at 5-15 West 125th Street, NewYork,NewYorkandknown asBlock1723,Lot31 and istheowneroftwootherparcelsof land located at 16 West 126"h Street, New York, New York and 18 West 126"h Street, New York, New York and known as Block 1723,Lots 144 and 45 respectively, all as shown on the Tax Mapof the City of NewYork,NewYork County and more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (all three parcels ofland herein called“Transferee's Land or"Transferee's Premises"); and WHEREAS, Transferee proposes to construct a new building on Transferee's Land, (said new building and improvements and any related improvements, additions, renovations, expansions, alterations, restorations, repairs, replacements and reconstructions thereto and thereof being collectively called "Transferee's New Building"); and WHEREAS,it is anticipated that Transferee's NewBuildingwill contain more floor area,as the term Floor Area is defined in the Zoning Resolution (the "Zoning Resolution") of the City of New York,effective as of December 15,1961,as amended from time to time,than is now available for use in respect of Transferee's Premises under the "floor area ratio" limitation contained in the Zoning Resolution, with the result that Transferee desires to utilize the procedure available under the G:MMD\Reisman\17W125\ZLDA2.doc

Zoning Resolution for combining Transferee's Premises and Transferor's Premises into a single "zoning lot" for the purpose of making available to Transferee additional Floor Area for inclusion in Transferee's New Building. WHEREAS,such procedure will make available to Transferee all of the currently unused Floor Area attributable to Transferor's Premises as of the date hereof, being all of the FloorArea currently available toTransferor's Premises under the current Zoning Resolution and the development rights associated with such unused Floor Area in excess of the Floor Area utilized by Transferor's Premises (hereinafter such unused Floor Area and associated development rights collectively referred to as the "Excess Development Rights"); and WHEREAS, The parties represent that the Floor Area currently used by Transferor's Premises is estimated to total approximately 45,578 square feet (hereinafter such used Floor Area shall be referred to as the “Retained Development Rights"); and WHEREAS, Transferor is willing to make the Excess Development Rights available to Transferee for the consideration recited in a certain purchase agreement, dated as of June 21, 2007 betweenTransferor and Transferee; and WHEREAS, Transferor and Transferee are simultaneously herewith executing and delivering a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions as referred to in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (definition of "zoning lot", paragraph (d)) ("Declaration", attached hereto as Schedule D), which ("Combined Zoning Lot") out of Transferee's Premises and Transferor's Premises; and NOW, THEREFORE,in consideration of the foregoing, Transferor and Transferee hereby agree as follows: (1) Certain Definitions.  As used herein: (a) "Floor Area", “floor area ratio","zoning lot", "part(ies) in interest","lot area", "use", and "non-complying" shall have the meanings set forth in S12-10 of the Zoning Resolution. (2) Transfer of Excess Zoning Rights; Easement of Light and Air. (i)Transferor hereby sells, conveys, assigns and transfers to Transferee all right, title and interest of utilize the Excess Development Rights in the construction of Transferee's New Building Or any future building or in any manner permitted under the Zoning Resolution that does notviolatethetermsofthisAgreement.
